data.name: Harisha
data.gender_notes: Harisha is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Harisha is a name derived from Sanskrit language, meaning 'God's Hara (protector) + Isha (lord)'. This name is often associated with the Hindu deity Hara, who is considered the protector and god of fertility, health, and wealth. The name Harisha represents power, protection, and lordship. The name Harisha carries the meaning “God's Hara (protector) + Isha (lord)” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Harisha usually hope their child will grow to embody god's hara (protector) + isha (lord) and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embodiment of protection and divine grace.
data.etymology: Harisha belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's Hara (protector) + Isha (lord).”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Harisha total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
